result.title: SceneTether: Activity-Gated Value Anchoring for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Image Animation
result.summary: Long-horizon image animation must keep the scene fixed while natural material (e.g., water, smoke, or fire) continues to move. Autoregressive video generators read recent frames for temporal continuity, but this history also carries accumulated appearance errors, and sparsifying it disrupts motion. We introduce SceneTether, a training-free attention-read policy that keeps where attention reads recent memory but changes what appearance that memory returns. SceneTether keeps every key of the newest latent, blends its low-activity values toward co-located source-image values, and leaves high-activity values untouched so motion can evolve; an activity map estimated from the first generated latents and then frozen decides where to blend. It adds no denoising evaluations and leaves the cache-update rule unchanged. On a Causal Forcing++ generator, SceneTether raises source-support PSNR by 5.15 dB over its framewise Echo host across two seeds with 1.5x its late activity, and by 7.31 dB over spatial Echo-Forcing on a preselected four-minute subset. At equal recent-memory coverage, value anchoring alone adds 8.14 dB. A post-hoc pixel composite with the same map matches static fidelity but retains nearly twice the moving-region color drift, and viewers in a small blinded study preferred SceneTether for its natural scene and motion preservation. Project page: https://minar09.github.io/scenetether/

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SceneTether，一种免训练的注意力读取策略：保留最新 latent 的全部 key，但把低活动区域的 value 向源图像同位置混合、高活动区域保持不变，用首轮生成估计并冻结的活动图决定混合位置，从而在长时程自回归图像动画中固定场景又保留运动。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「活动门控的 value 锚定」直接改变 KV 缓存向注意力返回的视觉内容，可能为 LVR 中如何在维持状态更新与运动的同时防止视觉细节漂移、信息坍缩提供可核查线索；但任务属图像动画生成，与多模态推理无直接关联。
